sql_calls.sql:
SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS ts, units_sold::text AS value1, revenue_inr::text AS value2, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, book_before::text, counted::text, trigger || '; adjustment=' || adjustment::text
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY source, ts;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS dataset, MIN(date)::text AS start_date, MAX(date)::text AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS skus
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku_scanned) FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL SELECT 'stock_counts', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.stock_counts;

SELECT date, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to, book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT audit_ts, status FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_sales_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_sales_date;

SELECT date, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to, book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT 'stock_counts' AS source, count_ts::text AS ts, book_before::text AS a, counted::text AS b, adjustment::text AS c, trigger AS d
FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, units::text, reason, NULL, NULL
FROM store.write_offs WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_orders', created_ts::text, order_id, units::text, cases::text, reason
FROM store.store_orders WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goods_receipts', received_ts::text, grn_id, shipment_id, asn_units::text, 'booked=' || units_booked::text || '; sku=' || sku_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts WHERE sku_booked = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY source, ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_max_ts,
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS atta_units_sold,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty_audits;

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';
